audit: E15 hard negatives (pet box at least 80 % inside the furniture box, labelled not 'on'), all splits
method: visual inspection of each image with the detection boxes drawn, by the developer agent (single reviewer, not an independent annotator)

items.finding: cat lying on the floor under the dining table; label correct (not on)
cat standing on a chair in front of the table; label correct (on the chair, not on the table)
dog lying under the table; label correct (not on)
cat sitting on the floor in front of the bed; label correct (not on)
small dog standing on the floor in front of a chair that another dog lies on; label correct (not on)

conclusion: All 5 labels are correct; all are 2-D containment failures (under, in front of, on another object). The rule is wrong on 5/5, the learned head on 4/5. Neither box-geometry method can separate these cases; 5 such negatives among 246 scorable pairs means the public data cannot measure this failure mode. Household recordings with 'in front of / beside / under' labels are required.
